block_row: Structural top: ports, interconnect and named instances only.

frame_row: Structural top of the asynchronous Gray-code synchronizer IP.

label: u_src
(m_vlsit_agray_sync_src)
blocks.function: Optional input register, binary-to-Gray encoding, Gray launch register.

label: u_dst
(m_vlsit_agray_sync_dst)
blocks.function: Gray synchronizer, Gray-to-binary decoding, optional output register.

interfaces.name: Source binary input
interfaces.signals: external -> TOP: i_data; TOP -> u_src: i_data

interfaces.name: Source clock and reset
interfaces.signals: SoC -> TOP: i_clk_src, i_rst_n_src; TOP -> u_src: i_clk_src, i_rst_n_src

interfaces.name: Destination clock and reset
interfaces.signals: SoC -> TOP: i_clk_dst, i_rst_n_dst; TOP -> u_dst: i_clk_dst, i_rst_n_dst

interfaces.name: Destination binary output
interfaces.signals: u_dst -> TOP: o_data; TOP -> external: o_data

legend_note: The enclosing frame is the top module; the two blocks are its instances. The Gray launch register is in u_src and the n-stage synchronizer instances are in u_dst. The Gray bus crosses from u_src to u_dst on the drawn GRAY connector. Each Gray bit is a one-bit toggle through m_vlsit_afifo_cell_sync; the single-bit-change Gray property makes the multi-bit crossing safe.
